title: Maya
desc: Apsara, a single mother, ends up watching a scary film for a contest. However, things take a horrifying turn when a ghost begins to haunt her.

title: Theeratha Vilayattu Pillai
desc: Karthik, a wealthy man with commitment issues, dates Priya, Jyothi and Tejaswini simultaneously, leading to chaos as his manipulative plans unravel.

title: Ayan
desc: Deva, a computer science student, works with a smuggler against his mother's wishes. His life unravels when his closest friend is murdered, leading him to help the police catch a powerful drug lord.

title: Dhilluku Dhuddu
desc: Kumar falls madly in love with his former classmate, Kajal, and decides to marry her. However, Kajal's father invites him to a haunted house in order to kill him.

title: Dharma Durai
desc: Dharmadurai, a heartbroken doctor, turns to alcohol and becomes the source of embarrassment for his family. However, a meeting with an old friend changes his life for good.
